questions.question: Identify the correct sentence that uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase.
options: Only after the meeting did we realize the mistake.
Only after the meeting realized we the mistake.
Only after the meeting we realized the mistake.
Only after the meeting had we realized the mistake.
questions.answer: Only after the meeting did we realize the mistake.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the location?
options: It was in London that the conference was held.
It was London where the conference was held.
It was in London which the conference was held.
It was London that the conference was held.
questions.answer: It was in London that the conference was held.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the conditional sentence that expresses a hypothetical situation in the past which is unlikely to have occurred.
options: If I had known about the party, I would go now.
If I had known about the party, I would have gone.
If I had known about the party, I would have gone then.
If I had known about the party, I would have gone to it.
questions.answer: If I had known about the party, I would have gone to it.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that appropriately uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation.
options: I suggest that the committee meets next week.
I suggest that the committee meeting next week.
I suggest that the committee should meet next week.
I suggest that the committee will meet next week.
questions.answer: I suggest that the committee should meet next week.

questions.question: Which option correctly uses ellipsis to maintain parallel structure in the sentence?
options: She is taller than her sister, but she is not as popular.
She is taller than her sister, but she is not as popular as her sister.
She is taller than her sister, but she is not as popular than her sister.
She is taller than her sister, but she is not as popular with her sister.
questions.answer: She is taller than her sister, but she is not as popular as her sister.
